Pour over coffee ratio

Most baristas use 1:15 to 1:17; start at 1:16 and adjust.

Water temperature

Hot but not boiling water, about 93 C, extracts sweetness without harsh bitterness in most cases.

Bloom time

Thirty seconds.

Grind size

Medium-fine.
